name: Sweep Bin
summary: A red Delete button with a two-step confirm, then a little bin hops across and eats the label
about: Sweep Bin keeps a tiny bin inside a red Delete button. The first press asks Really delete? with a 3-second countdown; the second makes the bin crouch, leap and hop across the button, chomping the words while crumbs fly. It finishes with a happy burp of smoke and a Deleted tick. Good for file managers, dashboards and any delete that deserves a second thought.
how: Hover to see the bin peek; press Delete once and the button shakes and asks Really delete? while a bar counts down 3 seconds.
Press again before the bar runs out (or press Esc to cancel).
The bin crouches, leaps, then hops across the button snapping its lid and eating the label while crumbs fly.
It burps a puff, the button turns dark and says Deleted with a tick, then the bin hops home and everything resets.
